headline: Bitcoin is stuck just under $60,000 as US stocks fall on a reported new tariff plan, while a surprise jump in consumer confidence keeps a December Fed rate hike close to fully priced ahead of Wednesday's inflation data.

market.asOf: Bitcoin price and 24h change from CoinDesk's live coverage at 10:09am ET (15:09 UTC) Tue 24 Nov; at that time CoinDesk said ether was down about 6% and solana about 10%. Ether and Solana prices could not be confirmed with a time this run. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 ("Extreme Fear") on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index, per FinanceFeeds (24 Nov); CoinDesk reported a reading of 9 earlier on 24 Nov without naming the index.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $60,000 as the Nvidia rally reverses and a tariff report hits stocks
stories.summary: Bitcoin has stayed just under $60,000 through the start of US trading. Stocks gave back part of Monday's Nvidia-driven rally after a report that the US could soon raise tariffs on many trading partners. Money keeps leaving US bitcoin funds, and more bitcoin is now held at a loss than ever before.
points: Bitcoin was at $59,800 at 10:09am ET (15:09 UTC), down 5.8% over 24 hours, per CoinDesk.

The Wall Street Journal reported the Trump administration could announce tariff hikes as soon as this week on China, Japan, South Korea and more than a dozen other countries; Nasdaq 100 futures fell 2.4% after the report, per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday 23 Nov, led by $509.3 million out of BlackRock's IBIT, per The Block.
November outflows from US spot bitcoin funds reached a record $4.71 billion, beating June's $4.5 billion, per Farside data cited by CoinDesk.
A record 11.6 million BTC is now held at a loss, per Glassnode data cited by CoinDesk.

stories.title: Consumer confidence jumps; a December Fed rate hike stays close to fully priced before Wednesday's inflation data
stories.summary: US consumer confidence came in far stronger than expected on Tuesday. Strong data gives the Federal Reserve little reason to back away from the rate rise markets expect at its 8-9 December meeting. Higher rates tend to weigh on risky assets like crypto. Wednesday's October PCE inflation report is the next big test.
points: The Conference Board's consumer confidence index rose 11.4 points to 103.3 in November from 91.9 in October, its highest since January 2025, per the Conference Board.
Forecasters had expected 92.1, per Yahoo Finance.
Fed funds futures priced a 95.1% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and 4.9% for a half-point hike, per Coinotag.
October PCE prices are expected to rise 0.3% on the month after 0.5% in September, per Binance News via TradingView; the report comes out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok).
US stock markets are closed on Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving, per ICE's holiday calendar.

stories.title: South Korea's draft crypto law would end its 2017 ban on token sales
stories.summary: South Korea's Financial Services Commission has proposed its Digital Asset Act. It would lift the ban on token sales (ICOs) the country imposed in 2017, as long as issuers file a white paper first. The bill still needs parliamentary approval.
points: The draft would end the ICO ban imposed in September 2017; issuers would file a white paper and could face a waiting period, possibly 7 days, before selling, per CoinDesk.
Issuers would also file shorter prospectuses for retail buyers, per CoinDesk.
False statements could bring fines, damages or criminal charges, per CoinDesk.
Exchanges would have to disclose hacks and changes in token supply, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: US seeks $1.17 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
briefs.summary: The Justice Department is seeking $1.17 billion in USDC tied to the Binance hack, and Circle could issue replacement tokens, per The Block.

briefs.title: Anchorage Digital launches an asset manager
briefs.summary: Anchorage Digital's new 61st Parallel Asset Management arm plans a bitcoin-denominated yield fund for custody clients, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Sky's stUSDS lending pool runs dry
briefs.summary: Sky cofounder Rune Christensen is weighing a sale of SKY tokens to repay $77 million as the stUSDS pool runs dry, per The Block.

briefs.title: Trader Ansem says his Solana wallet was hacked
briefs.summary: Trader Ansem says his Solana wallet was compromised through his Bullpen profile, after 2.15 million USDC was moved out; some analysts doubt the account, per Unchained.

briefs.title: CFTC prediction-market rules go to White House review
briefs.summary: The CFTC's prediction-market rules have gone to the White House for review while 44 state attorneys general oppose the rulemaking, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy and Metaplanet leave MSCI indexes on 30 Nov
briefs.summary: Strategy leaves the MSCI USA Index and Metaplanet the MSCI Japan Small Cap Index at the close on 30 Nov, per The Block.
